Business process management · Structure · Tested
In 1 minute

SOP review

Lucia · Document Control Specialist

A generic drug manufacturer maintains 640 procedures that must be reviewed every 2 years, about 27 a month.

When it runs
On the 1st of every month, with the list of SOPs expiring in the next 60 days extracted from the document management system
What it delivers in production
For each SOP in the month's queue, a tracked change proposal (what changes, why and based on which record) and a list of decisions for the process owner, 60 days before expiry.
Who decides
Proposes; process owner and reviewer decide
Effort
Calibrate on 12 reviews; 2 months of full approval
Set up5 steps · 8 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

# SOP change template and periodic review rules

SOP = standard operating procedure. QA = quality assurance.

## Change form
Code | Item and excerpt | From / To | Source (cm_id, dv_id or standard) | Impact
- Number A1, A2, A3 following the order of the SOP items.
- Write From and To with the SOP text, without rewriting the style.

## Period and validity
- Review period: records dated after the effective date of the current version. What is earlier is already in the version.
- SOP validity: 2 years from the effective date.

## Criteria
- Change control that cites the SOP in the period: change in the item the description indicates.
- 2 or more deviations in the same item in the period: reinforced verification in the item, with the dv_id values as source.
- Standard with a cited version different from the current one: update the reference in item 2.
- Deviation that asks for a change in frequency, time, temperature or limit: DECISIONS, never a change.
- SOP with another number in cross_references.csv that cites a changed item: DECISIONS, review together.

## Rules with no leeway
- Outside the period does not count. E.g.: CM-2024-077 and DV-2024-090 are earlier than Nov 20, 2024; item 6 has 2 deviations in the period, not 3.
- A parameter only changes with a value coming from change control. E.g.: DV-2026-040 asks for a higher frequency in item 7; it goes to DECISIONS and item 7 does not change.
- REMAIN UNCHANGED lists every item with no proposed change, even with a record. E.g.: items 1, 3, 4 and 7.
- Count and escalation. E.g.: 4 changes (items 2, 5, 6 and 8) and a frequency decision: meeting with the quality assurance manager and change control before the new version. All thresholds apply.

## Excluded excerpt
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear in any part of the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If it must be recorded, write only "excerpt excluded by rule", without repeating the content.

## One single pass
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

SOP-EMB-017 | Version 04 | Effective: 2024-11-20
Title: Blister machine cleaning
Prepared by: Packaging Production | Approved by: Quality Assurance

1. Purpose
Define the cleaning of the blister machine between batches and at product changeover.

2. References
RDC 658/2022. Equipment Cleaning and Sanitization Guide, 2019 version. Brazilian Pharmacopoeia, 6th edition.

3. Responsibilities
The line operator performs the cleaning. The packaging supervisor verifies and signs the record.

4. Materials
Alkaline detergent as per item 5, 70% alcohol and lint-free cloths.

5. Washing
Apply the alkaline detergent Alcaclean at 2% for 10 minutes and rinse with purified water at 60 °C for 5 minutes.

6. Inspection
Visually check the cavities of the forming mold.

7. Frequency
Full cleaning at every product changeover and weekly.

8. Record
Fill in form FR-017-01 at the end of each cleaning.

Step 5 of 5 · Use

Replace the sample with your data

Do this
  1. 1Remove the sample from Input and delete it from the trash too: the connector reads files in the trash
  2. 2Replace the sample in the knowledge base with your company's text
  3. 3On the 1st of each month, export from the document management system the SOP expiring in the next 60 days (PDF or DOCX) and, from the quality systems, the changes, deviations, standards and cross references to the Input folder; click ▶
  4. 4Replace the form template and the criteria in the knowledge base with your quality assurance team's, with the validity of the SOPs
  5. 5After a few approved reviews, connect Slack to send the proposal to the process owner and the reviewer, with approval before each send; the new version is saved in the validated system by an authorized person

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The agent drafts a proposal; the document in the validated system is changed by an authorized person, because the document management system is validated and writes by an agent would require revalidation and a regulatory impact assessment. Every change cites the originating change control, deviation or standard: a proposal with no origin is discarded, however reasonable it looks. Frequency, process parameters and acceptance limits never change through an agent proposal, only through a change control with a study.

Common mistakes

  • Approving the periodic review unchanged by default because the reviewer found nothing; a review with no change requires a written justification and a cross-check with deviations.
  • Changing an SOP and forgetting the documents that reference it; a change to one item breaks the work instruction that points to it.
  • Changing a process parameter (time, temperature, frequency) in a periodic review; that is a change control with a study, not a document review.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Analyst hours per SOP reviewfrom 6 to 8 hours to 2 to 3 hoursestimate based on the described routine
SOPs overdue on the internal audit datefrom 14% to less than 2%estimate based on the described routine
Approved changes that the agent had proposed80% or more in calibration on 12 reviewsestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. SOP-PRD-042 v05, Cleaning of the oral liquids filler. Expires on 2026-10-28. Records for the period: 2 change controls, 3 deviations, 1 updated standard.
A1 | Item 6.3, sanitizer contact time | from 10 min to 15 min | origin: change control CM-2025-118 (sanitizer replacement) | impact: revalidate cleaning record
A2 | Item 7.1, visual check | add a check of dosing nozzle 4 | origin: deviations DV-2026-031, DV-2026-057 and DV-2026-088 (residue on nozzle 4 in 3 batches)
A3 | Item 2, references | update the version of the cited cleaning guide | origin: standard updated in 2026-03
REMAIN UNCHANGED: items 1, 3, 4, 5 and 8 (no linked record in the period).
D1 | Deviation DV-2026-057 suggests the full cleaning interval is too long; changing the frequency requires a study. Open a change control?
D2 | SOP-PRD-118 references item 6.3, changed in A1; review them together?
